title: Browser extension ('Make worksheet from this')
description: Chrome + Firefox + Edge extension: select any text on a webpage (BBC Bitesize, Tes, Twinkl, etc.), right-click, 'Make worksheet from this' → opens app.adaptly.co.uk/worksheets in a new tab with the selected text pre-filled as the topic source and the URL captured as sourceCitation.
rationale: User's improvement #12 (f). Captures the moment a teacher reads a great article and wishes a worksheet existed. Two seconds of friction removed from a daily motion.
constraints: Manifest V3 only (Chrome's V2 sunset). Firefox is MV3-compatible enough for our context-menu + tabs usage.

Extension runs entirely in the user's browser; the only network call it makes is opening the Adaptly tab via window.open with the selection encoded into a URL fragment (avoids hitting any extension store privacy review tripwires).
Extension ships as its own repo subfolder `/extension/` with its own build script; not bundled into the main Vite build.
steps: Add /extension/ workspace with: manifest.json (MV3), background.ts (context menu registration), content.ts (listens for context-menu click, captures selection, opens new tab).

App side: Worksheets.tsx checks for `?sharedFrom=ext`; if present, reads the fragment (encoded so we don't hit URL-length limits in the query), pre-fills topic + additionalInstructions, sets sourceCitation field for PB1's provenance pass.
Submit to Chrome Web Store + Firefox AMO via separate ops process — out of scope for the code PR.
- /extension/tests/extension.test.ts — happy-path mock of chrome.contextMenus + window.open call assertion.
do_not_touch: Vite config — extension is a separate build pipeline
WeekAhead handoff or Share-Target handoff in Worksheets.tsx — distinct one-shot useEffect each
acceptance_criteria: Extension loads in Chrome, Firefox, Edge as MV3 unpacked.
Right-clicking a selection on a webpage shows 'Make worksheet from this' in the context menu.
Clicking it opens a new tab with /worksheets pre-filled.
Tests pass; main app build still passes (extension build is independent).
verification: Manual: select text on bbc.co.uk/bitesize; right-click; confirm new tab opens with topic pre-filled.
pnpm run check + pnpm run build (main app).
context_budget_for_fresh_chat: LOW–MEDIUM. Extension is greenfield; no repo reads required other than Worksheets.tsx URL-param logic.
